title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Yaanai
desc: Ravi, the youngest son of an influential family accused of causing a man's death, takes charge of defending them. However, amidst the turmoil, he unexpectedly falls for a woman.

title: Kakkakuyil
desc: Sivaraman arrives in Mumbai in search of a job, but finds an old friend instead. Circumstances force them to rob a bank and they end up homeless.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Saamy
desc: Aarusaamy, a police officer, accepts bribes from Perumal, a gangster, in order to maintain peace in his district. However, circumstances force him to go against Perumal.
